releaseCheck.title: Release checklist
releaseCheck.subtitle: Track every OTA decision against a version and its evidence.
releaseCheck.emptyBody: Set the baseline, then review scope, shared issues, upgrade validation and release artifacts. Each version keeps its own record.
releaseCheck.noBlocked: No blocked checks in this stage
releaseCheck.noRemaining: All checks in this stage are complete
releaseCheck.notePlaceholder: Record the build and result. For blockers, include next steps and an expected date.
releaseCheck.evidencePlaceholder: Reports, issues, commits or Feishu messages. Multiple references are supported.
releaseCheck.newHint: The baseline and branches stay with this version. Create a new checklist when the baseline changes.
releaseCheck.loadFailed: Could not read local checklists. Retry to keep existing records intact.
releaseCheck.saveFailed: Could not save. Check local storage and retry; your current input is retained.
releaseCheck.conflict: The record has changed, or the version name already exists. Reload and review.
releaseCheck.validation: Passed checks require an owner, notes and evidence. Not applicable requires an owner and a reason.
releaseCheck.blockValidation: Assign an owner and describe the blocker and next steps.
releaseCheck.guide.scope: Confirm product requirements, customer issues and internal must-fix items with their owners. Apply the OTA label and record reviews for changes after scope freeze.
releaseCheck.guide.branch: Choose the MP or mainline strategy and record SYS / VND baselines. Review feature dependencies, decoupling and the full code delta.
releaseCheck.guide.common: Map shared defects to affected configurations and projects. Record this project’s fixes, validation or deferral decisions; revisit them when related projects change their decision.
releaseCheck.guide.certification: Agree the MR / SMR path with the GMS team. Check the GMS package, features, security patch, fingerprint, base_os, modem baseline and validity dates.
releaseCheck.guide.dependencies: Confirm delivery dates for platform fixes, algorithm licenses, customer APKs and Google app compatibility changes. Identify dependencies without a solution or date.
releaseCheck.guide.schedule: Assign dates and owners for internal tests, stress tests, fixes, customer acceptance, GMS testing and approval. Base the release schedule on scope and branch review.
releaseCheck.guide.commits: Match every scoped item to target-branch commits and the candidate build. Verify features, spec, macros, overlays, product identity and bundled apps. Review late merges and reverts.
releaseCheck.guide.apps: Test bundled and latest Play versions. For call recording, cover incoming calls during SIM selection, manual/automatic recording and hangup. Check file navigation after reset and update, before first launch.
releaseCheck.guide.stability: Validate long camera sessions, mode changes, memory trends, black screens and recovery against platform risks. Verify the stress script ran successfully and retain builds, durations and logs.
releaseCheck.guide.upgrade: Build and install OTA packages from deployed market versions. Verify delta size, installation, data and settings retention, then boot, launcher, telephony and camera behavior.
releaseCheck.guide.artifacts: Retain the original OTA inputs, manifest, build metadata and checksums. Verify backup completeness and that release, acceptance and rollout versions match.
releaseCheck.guide.approval: Match required internal and laboratory results and Google approval to the candidate build. Check patch validity and customer licensing requirements.
releaseCheck.guide.customer: Collect customer acceptance. Record impact, reproduction conditions, customer agreement and the next OTA for deferrals. Reassess decisions when new logs or evidence arrive.
releaseCheck.guide.handoff: Verify release notes, version records, upgrade paths, rollout scope and incident owners. Confirm how post-release feedback and rollout stops will be handled.
releaseCheck.unsavedReport: Save this version’s pending edits before copying its report.
